scope: Two sequential six-second simulated Main Street runs. All GPU RGB/depth/cloud/LiDAR, detector and available Modelica INS baseline; not full visual SLAM.

environment.instrumentation: CDP workers + owned browser perf sampling; shared machine

limitations: Low and High use different requested sensor rates; not equal-work speedup
Profiles precede Configuration-tab and shared IMU transport-validator build; recorded bundle hashes identify exact run
Source hashes below are documentation snapshot after shared IMU validator refactor, not the measured bundle
30 FPS final windows do not prove every frame met 33.3 ms deadline
No laptop or full SLAM acceptance

workload.profile: Modelica inertial propagation with RGB-D feature detection; full SLAM is not measured

browserCpu.method: CDP process CPU deltas after warmup; includes profiler overhead
